@20 Transfer applicants: The information on this grid is for first-year applicants only. To see which institutions accept the Common App for transfer, and what their specific requirements are, please consult www.commonapp.org.
@20 1. Coed indicates a coeducational college, Women indicates a women's college, Men indicates a men's college, and Coordinate indicates two “coordinate” single-sex colleges geographically adjacent to each other that share an
@21 admission process, courses, faculty, etc.

@20 A: Tests Always Required, F: Test Flexible, I: Tests Ignored, N: Tests Never Required, S: Tests Sometimes Required.
